/bin/sh -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: adjust_inventory.py
+import sqlite3
+
+
+def adjust_inventory() -> None:
+    connection = sqlite3.connect(\"inventory.db\")
+    try:
+        connection.execute(\"BEGIN\")
+        connection.execute(\"UPDATE products SET quantity = ? WHERE name = ?\", (8, \"Widget\"))
+        connection.execute(
+            \"INSERT INTO products (id, name, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?)\",
+            (4, \"Doodad\", 3),
+        )
+        connection.execute(\"SAVEPOINT before_gadget\")
+        connection.commit()
+    except Exception:
+        connection.rollback()
+        raise
+    finally:
+        connection.close()
+
+
+if __name__ == \"__main__\":
+    adjust_inventory()
*** End Patch
PATCH
python3 -m py_compile adjust_inventory.py"
